---- MODULE MultiShardTxnSnapshot ----
EXTENDS MultiShardTxnSnapshotDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

LOCAL MSTProof == INSTANCE TLAPS
LOCAL MSTFold == INSTANCE FoldsTheorems

LEMMA MSTEmptyFold ==
    ASSUME NEW f(_, _), NEW a
    PROVE ReduceSeq(f, <<>>, a) = a
BY MSTFold!MapThenFoldSetEmpty
   DEF ReduceSeq, FoldFunction, FoldFunctionOnSet,
       MapThenFoldSet, MSTFold!MapThenFoldSet

MSTPermBody(S, f) ==
    [ss \in SUBSET S |->
       IF ss = {} THEN {<<>>}
       ELSE LET ps == [x \in ss |->
                       {Append(sq, x) : sq \in f[ss \ {x}]}]
            IN UNION {ps[x] : x \in ss}]

LEMMA MSTEmptyPermBody ==
    \A f : MSTPermBody({}, f) = [ss \in SUBSET {} |-> {<<>>}]
BY MSTProof!SetExtensionality, MSTProof!SMTT("r3") DEF MSTPermBody

LEMMA MSTEmptyPermutations == PermSeqs({}) = {<<>>}
<1> DEFINE q == CHOOSE f : f = MSTPermBody({}, f)
           p == [ss \in SUBSET {} |-> {<<>>}]
<1>1. \A f : (f = MSTPermBody({}, f)) <=> f = p
  BY MSTEmptyPermBody DEF p
<1>2. q = p
  BY <1>1 DEF q
<1>3. PermSeqs({}) = q[{}]
  BY DEF PermSeqs, q, MSTPermBody
<1> QED BY <1>2, <1>3, MSTProof!SetExtensionality, MSTProof!SMTT("r2") DEF p

LEMMA MSTSingletonPermBody ==
    ASSUME NEW t, NEW f
    PROVE (f = MSTPermBody({t}, f)) <=>
          f = [ss \in SUBSET {t} |->
                   IF ss = {} THEN {<<>>} ELSE {<<t>>}]
<1> DEFINE p == [ss \in SUBSET {t} |->
                   IF ss = {} THEN {<<>>} ELSE {<<t>>}]
<1>1. \A ss \in SUBSET {t} : ss = {} \/ ss = {t}
  BY MSTProof!SetExtensionality, MSTProof!SMTT("r2")
<1>2. Append(<<>>, t) = <<t>>
  BY MSTProof!SetExtensionality, MSTProof!SMTT("r2")
<1>3. ASSUME f = MSTPermBody({t}, f)
      PROVE f = p
  <2>1. f[{}] = {<<>>}
    BY <1>3, <1>1, MSTProof!SetExtensionality, MSTProof!SMTT("r2") DEF MSTPermBody
  <2>2. f[{t}] = {<<t>>}
    BY <1>3, <1>1, <1>2, <2>1, MSTProof!SetExtensionality, MSTProof!SMTT("r3") DEF MSTPermBody
  <2> QED BY <1>3, <1>1, <2>1, <2>2, MSTProof!SetExtensionality, MSTProof!SMTT("r3")
           DEF MSTPermBody, p
<1>4. p = MSTPermBody({t}, p)
  <2>1. p[{}] = {<<>>} /\ p[{t}] = {<<t>>}
    BY MSTProof!SMTT("r2") DEF p
  <2>2. MSTPermBody({t}, p)[{}] = {<<>>}
    BY MSTProof!SMTT("r2") DEF MSTPermBody
  <2>3. MSTPermBody({t}, p)[{t}] = {<<t>>}
    BY <1>2, <2>1, MSTProof!SetExtensionality, MSTProof!SMTT("r3")
       DEF MSTPermBody
  <2> QED BY <1>1, <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, MSTProof!SMTT("r3")
          DEF MSTPermBody, p
<1> QED BY <1>3, <1>4 DEF p

LEMMA MSTSingletonPermutations ==
    ASSUME NEW t
    PROVE PermSeqs({t}) = {<<t>>}
<1> DEFINE q == CHOOSE f : f = MSTPermBody({t}, f)
           p == [ss \in SUBSET {t} |->
                   IF ss = {} THEN {<<>>} ELSE {<<t>>}]
<1>1. \A f : (f = MSTPermBody({t}, f)) <=> f = p
  BY MSTSingletonPermBody DEF p
<1>2. q = p
  BY <1>1 DEF q
<1>3. PermSeqs({t}) = q[{t}]
  BY DEF PermSeqs, q, MSTPermBody
<1> QED BY <1>2, <1>3, MSTProof!SetExtensionality, MSTProof!SMTT("r2") DEF p

MSTIntersectBody(S, f) ==
    [ss \in SUBSET {S} |->
       IF ss = {} THEN UNION {S}
       ELSE LET x == CHOOSE x \in ss : TRUE
            IN x \intersect f[ss \ {x}]]

LEMMA MSTIntersectFixed ==
    ASSUME NEW S, NEW f
    PROVE (f = MSTIntersectBody(S, f)) <=>
          f = [ss \in SUBSET {S} |-> S]
<1> DEFINE p == [ss \in SUBSET {S} |-> S]
<1>0. UNION {S} = S /\ S \intersect S = S
  BY MSTProof!Isa
<1>1. \A ss \in SUBSET {S} : ss = {} \/ ss = {S}
  BY MSTProof!SMTT("r2")
<1>2. (CHOOSE x \in {S} : TRUE) = S
  BY MSTProof!SMTT("r2")
<1>3. ASSUME f = MSTIntersectBody(S, f)
      PROVE f = p
  <2>1. f[{}] = S
    BY <1>0, <1>3, MSTProof!SMTT("r2") DEF MSTIntersectBody
  <2>2. f[{S}] = S
    BY <1>0, <1>3, <1>2, <2>1, MSTProof!SMTT("r2") DEF MSTIntersectBody
  <2> QED BY <1>3, <1>1, <2>1, <2>2, MSTProof!SMTT("r3")
          DEF MSTIntersectBody, p
<1>4. p = MSTIntersectBody(S, p)
  <2>1. p[{}] = S /\ p[{S}] = S
    BY MSTProof!SMTT("r2") DEF p
  <2>2. MSTIntersectBody(S, p)[{}] = S
    BY <1>0, MSTProof!SMTT("r2") DEF MSTIntersectBody
  <2>3. MSTIntersectBody(S, p)[{S}] = S
    BY <1>0, <1>2, <2>1, MSTProof!SMTT("r2") DEF MSTIntersectBody
  <2> QED BY <1>1, <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, MSTProof!SMTT("r3")
          DEF MSTIntersectBody, p
<1> QED BY <1>3, <1>4 DEF p

LEMMA MSTSingletonIntersection ==
    ASSUME NEW S
    PROVE INTERSECTION({S}) = S
<1> DEFINE q == CHOOSE f : f = MSTIntersectBody(S, f)
           p == [ss \in SUBSET {S} |-> S]
<1>1. \A f : (f = MSTIntersectBody(S, f)) <=> f = p
  BY MSTIntersectFixed DEF p
<1>2. q = p
  BY <1>1 DEF q
<1>3. INTERSECTION({S}) = q[{S}]
  BY DEF INTERSECTION, ReduceSet, q, MSTIntersectBody
<1> QED BY <1>2, <1>3, MSTProof!SMTT("r2") DEF p

LEMMA MSTEmptyTransactionCT ==
    ASSUME NEW a
    PROVE CC!CT_SI(<<>>, <<[parentState |-> a, transaction |-> <<>>]>>)
<1> DEFINE e == <<[parentState |-> a, transaction |-> <<>>]>>
<1>1. CC!executionStates(e) = <<a>> /\ CC!parentState(e, <<>>) = a
  BY MSTProof!SMTT("r3") DEF e, CC!executionStates, CC!parentState
<1>2. CC!SeqToSet(CC!executionStates(e)) = {a}
  BY <1>1, MSTProof!SMTT("r2") DEF CC!SeqToSet
<1>3. CC!beforeOrEqualInExecution(e, a, a)
  BY <1>1, MSTProof!SMTT("r3") DEF CC!beforeOrEqualInExecution, CC!Index
<1>4. CC!SeqToSet(<<>>) = {} /\ CC!WriteSet(<<>>) = {}
  BY MSTProof!SMTT("r2") DEF CC!SeqToSet, CC!WriteSet
<1>5. CC!Complete(e, <<>>, a)
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, MSTSingletonIntersection
     DEF CC!Complete, CC!INTERSECTION, INTERSECTION, CC!ReduceSet, ReduceSet
<1>6. CC!NoConf(e, <<>>, a)
  BY <1>1, <1>4, MSTProof!SMTT("r2") DEF CC!NoConf
<1> QED BY <1>2, <1>5, <1>6, MSTProof!SMTT("r2") DEF CC!CT_SI, e

LEMMA MSTEmptyInitialOps ==
    Init => Range(ops) \subseteq {<<>>}
BY MSTProof!SetExtensionality, MSTProof!SMTT("r2") DEF Init, Range

MSTCommitStep == \E s \in Shard, t \in TxId : ShardTxnCommit(s, t)

LEMMA MSTInitialSingleWrite == Init => SingleWritePerKey
BY MSTEmptyInitialOps, MSTProof!SMTT("r2")
   DEF SingleWritePerKey, WritesEachKeyAtMostOnce

LEMMA MSTIsolationStuttering ==
    UNCHANGED ops => (SnapshotIsolation <=> SnapshotIsolation')
BY MSTProof!SMTT("r2") DEF SnapshotIsolation, InitialState, Range

LEMMA MSTOnlyCommitChangesOps ==
    [Next]_vars => (UNCHANGED ops \/ MSTCommitStep)
BY MSTProof!SMTT("r5")
   DEF Next, vars, MSTCommitStep,
       RouterTxnStart, RouterTxnOp, RouterTxnCoordinateCommit,
       RouterTxnCommitReadOnly, RouterTxnCommitSingleShard,
       ShardTxnStart, ShardTxnRead, ShardTxnWrite,
       ShardTxnCoordinateCommit, ShardTxnCoordinatorRecvCommitVote,
       ShardTxnCoordinatorDecideCommit, ShardTxnPrepare, ShardTxnAbort

LEMMA MSTNonCommitPreservesIsolation ==
    SnapshotIsolation /\ [Next]_vars /\ ~MSTCommitStep
        => SnapshotIsolation'
BY MSTOnlyCommitChangesOps, MSTIsolationStuttering, MSTProof!SMTT("r2")

LEMMA MSTRemoveStutteringBracket ==
    [SnapshotIsolation => SnapshotIsolation']_vars
        => (SnapshotIsolation => SnapshotIsolation')
BY MSTIsolationStuttering, MSTProof!SMTT("r2") DEF vars

\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM SnapshotIsolationCorrect ==
    (Spec /\ []SingleWritePerKey) => []SnapshotIsolation
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF MongoDB/MultiShardTxnSnapshot_SnapshotIsolationCorrect.tla
<1>1. Init => SnapshotIsolation
  <2>1. Init => Range(ops) \subseteq {<<>>}
    BY MSTEmptyInitialOps
  <2>2. CC!SnapshotIsolation(InitialState, {})
    BY MSTEmptyPermutations, MSTEmptyFold
       DEF CC!SnapshotIsolation, CC!satisfyIsolationLevel,
           CC!executions, CC!PermSeqs, PermSeqs,
           CC!ReduceSeq, ReduceSeq, CC!FoldFunction, FoldFunction,
           CC!FoldFunctionOnSet, FoldFunctionOnSet,
           CC!MapThenFoldSet, MapThenFoldSet
  <2>3. CC!CT_SI(<<>>,
            <<[parentState |-> InitialState, transaction |-> <<>>]>>)
    BY MSTEmptyTransactionCT
  \* The singleton initial execution witness remains to be discharged.
  <2>4. <<[parentState |-> InitialState, transaction |-> <<>>]>>
            \in CC!executions(InitialState, {<<>>})
    BY MSTSingletonPermutations, MSTEmptyFold, MSTProof!SMTT("r5")
       DEF CC!executions, CC!PermSeqs, PermSeqs,
           CC!ReduceSeq, ReduceSeq, CC!FoldFunction, FoldFunction,
           CC!FoldFunctionOnSet, FoldFunctionOnSet,
           CC!MapThenFoldSet, MapThenFoldSet
  <2>5. Init => (Range(ops) = {} \/ Range(ops) = {<<>>})
    BY <2>1, MSTProof!SetExtensionality, MSTProof!SMTT("r3")
  <2> QED BY <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, MSTProof!SMTT("r3")
          DEF SnapshotIsolation, CC!SnapshotIsolation, CC!satisfyIsolationLevel
<1>2. (Spec /\ []SingleWritePerKey) =>
          [][SnapshotIsolation /\ MSTCommitStep => SnapshotIsolation']_vars
  \* Remaining protocol obligation: a reachable commit preserves the
  \* existence of a complete, conflict-free execution.  This needs a
  \* stronger invariant relating ops, log, and the transaction snapshots.
  BY MSTProof!PTL DEF Spec
<1>3. (Spec /\ []SingleWritePerKey) =>
          [][SnapshotIsolation => SnapshotIsolation']_vars
  BY <1>2, MSTNonCommitPreservesIsolation, MSTProof!PTL DEF Spec
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>3, MSTRemoveStutteringBracket, MSTProof!PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF MongoDB/MultiShardTxnSnapshot_SnapshotIsolationCorrect.tla
====
